name: 厨房用纸卷纸家用吸水款
description: 草绿主张页、台面吸液与撕取分档演示，整箱交付收口

styleLock.direction: clean bright household paper commerce with a bold single-colour claim page
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless paper-white packshot field, flat grass-green single-colour claim field, matte light-stone and warm neutral surfaces for scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with fill, one clean contact or crescent shadow per object, no mixed light directions
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter and warm paper-white boards, plain corrugate for delivery shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short headline plus three stacked labels maximum, all copy carried by placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in the accent colour, one icon per label, flat and unembellished
styleLock.presentationRules: the pack keeps a stable slight 3/4 read and consistent scale across the set; sheets are shown flat or in clean side profile; no packaging artwork is redrawn
noDrift: no invented numbers, seals or partner artwork
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean household paper commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless paper-white background #FFFFFF, flat grass-green claim field #1CA141, warm yellow accent #F2C400 and charcoal text #2D2D2D; neutral bright high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key and one clean contact shadow per object; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; premium product photography mixed with minimal flat infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 pack angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers or certification artwork.

shots.intent: 在搜索结果页用整组提装阵列一眼建立数量感与规格预期，赢得点击。
shots.camera: straight-on eye level with a slight 3/4 turn, receding rows of identical packs
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with fill, clean contact shadow under each pack
shots.whitespace: even white margin all around the group, no copy area
shots.promptTemplate: Clean e-commerce packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Identical shrink-wrapped packs of {product} arranged in receding rows so the group reads as one full set, photographed straight-on at eye level with a slight 3/4 turn so the front face and one flank read together. Bright even high-key studio light with a soft front-left key and fill, one clean contact shadow under each pack grounding it on the surface. Seamless paper-white studio sweep #FFFFFF. The front group occupies 60-70% of the frame, with an even white margin around it and no copy area. Negative: no added or redrawn logos, no pack counts or numeric badges printed into the frame, no floating packs, no duplicated pack artefacts, no props, no hands, no extra text, no watermark, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 用单色主张页配三条勾选卖点，一秒传达本品最核心的选购理由。
shots.camera: straight-on eye level, pack anchored low right against a hard shelf line
shots.lighting: soft front key with one crisp side shadow thrown onto the green field
shots.background: flat grass-green single-colour field #1CA141 with a slightly darker base band
shots.props: three thin-line tick marks and one small blank badge outline
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left 55% for headline and stacked labels
shots.textZone: left 55% column, one headline plus three stacked tick labels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One shrink-wrapped pack of {product} sits low right on a flat grass-green single-colour field #1CA141 with a hard shelf line and a darker base band, photographed straight-on at eye level. Soft front key light casting one crisp side shadow onto the green. The upper left 55% stays as generous negative space carrying a short headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 in charcoal #2D2D2D above three thin-line tick marks, each with one short label placeholder 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」. The pack occupies 50-60% of the frame. Negative: no long body copy, no more than one claim per line, no percentages or multiplier symbols, no comparison wording against other brands, no slogan lettering, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实早餐台面事故里，让买家代入自己厨房的擦液瞬间。
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down along the counter
shots.lighting: soft diffused window light from the left, 5500K, gentle contact shadows
shots.background: matte light-stone kitchen counter #EFEDE9 with a soft white wall
shots.props: one amber squeeze bottle, one green bowl of mixed berries, a spoon, a small liquid spill, one hand pressing a sheet
shots.whitespace: open counter in the foreground, no copy area
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} standing behind a spill being wiped on a matte light-stone kitchen counter #EFEDE9 against a soft white wall. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down along the counter. Soft diffused window light from the left at 5500K with gentle contact shadows and one clean shadow direction. Props: one unbranded amber squeeze bottle, one green bowl of mixed berries, a spoon, a small syrup-like spill and a single hand pressing a sheet flat, the hand visible only from the wrist with no face in frame. {product} occupies 40-50% of the frame, foreground counter kept open with no copy area. Negative: no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size, no branding on props, no visible face, no hands covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 放大宠物脚印与手作胶渍两类高频脏乱场景，制造立刻解决的冲动。
shots.camera: upper panel high 45-degree angle, lower panel 90-degree overhead flat lay
shots.lighting: same soft daylight key on both panels, identical shadow direction

Lower panel: a single sheet lifting glitter glue off a paper-white craft table #F4F2EE, photographed from directly above at a 90-degree overhead flat lay angle with craft props pushed to the edges. Both panels share one soft daylight key and the same shadow direction. {product} enters only as one clean wrapped pack tucked into the lower right corner, the two panels occupied 40-50% overall with open corners kept clear. Negative: no readable words inside either panel, no percentages or before-after labels, no exaggerated grime, no visible faces, no duplicated hands, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.whitespace: blank caption strip along the bottom, clean air above the funnels

One pad holds a square sheet from {product}, the other an unbranded plain neutral sheet with no marks of any kind, both drinking the same tinted liquid. shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right sweeping across the embossing
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of a single embossed sheet torn from {product}, tight zoom on the quilted fibre pattern and the torn edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field at f/3.2 with the foreground fibres razor sharp and the frame falling away behind. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic sheen, no repeating stamp pattern artefacts, no loose lint scattered everywhere, no texture that is not the product's own, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：第一张为白底多包提装阵列；第二张为草绿单色主张页配三条勾选卖点；第三张为浅色台面倾倒液与手部擦拭场景；第四张为上下双格脏污痛点（木地板脚印、手作桌胶渍）；第五张为展开单张配竖向虚线分档；第六张为双塔漏斗滴液吸液台架对比；第七张为绿底三档卷径俯视阶梯配空条；第八张为压纹与撕边微距素材（取自第五张纸面）；第九张为白底菱形纹样加森林插画的信任版面；第十张为俯视瓦楞纸箱开箱；第十一张为纸箱加提装扇形收口。品类判定依据：画面全部为厨房台面吸液擦拭场景与卷状吸液纸，非贴身如厕用纸，故判 L1 家居日用 / L2 纸品清洁 / leaf 厨房用纸卷纸；源提示的类目路径仅作线索，库内已另有卷筒卫生纸提装款，本款 slug 以 chufangzhijin 做语义区分。已剥离内容：源品牌字标、系列名与包装印刷艺术、倍率与张数与天数类数量对比断言、滴液实验参数数值、零售商与平台角标、箱号与条形码、合作机构环保主张原句，以及全部图内英文文案；上述断言一律不入稿，图内文字改为 {selling_point}/{callout} 占位或空白印章框，对比台架与规格阶梯均写为空白条与空读数。
